purpose: One necessary taskSVD deletion control of fixed82ff numerical A/B mechanism;no test-based repair or replacement.
A_rule: Remove both task singular-space projectors. Use unique rowwise minimum-Frobenius equality solution deltaAi=-(Ai dot A0i)/norm(A0i)^2*A0i. Keep same3072row anchoring conditions and same lastMLP;report any zero rows and actual distance,do not choose amplitude.
B_rule: Remove task32 response group. Same30class/environment normalized functional groups,cyclicwrongclass targets,shared B ridge rho.01,one31->30dim simplex SLSQP maxiter200 ftol1e-8;gradientcheckandFP64ridge unchanged.
reuse_scope: Reuse only original-expert/public-clean caches,teacher classes and original-readout prototypes,all independent of protectedpoint. Do not read mainpoint or any real-score files for construction. No new pixel generation,seed,strength,rank orlayer selection.
evaluation: Freeze sole control point first;then same complete nativeMNIST and MNIST/SVHN TA.5/originalAGA target-only/both,no source-confidence selection. Identical original unprotected scores/partnerAGA reused. Report source accuracy,logicaldistance,oldstrictR and native.5pp criterion separately;no main replacement.
interpretation: This removes the combined taskSVD constraints;it does not isolate A and B task constraints individually. Actual distances may differ as consequence of removal;do not rescale based on results. One control cannot certify all tasks or show novelty of ordinary SVD/ridge.
